text:
Elena (CSM): FYI we got a request from Marco at VitaMed for a compact enablement sprint this coming Saturday. They want a single-day run: infra workshop, PM-focused demo, and a short office-hours window. Theyre hoping this will de-risk their Dedicated migration ahead of renewal talks. Can we staff and confirm prework?

Tom (CS Ops): Weekend support ok from ops side if we have clear runbook and on-call. I can be on-call Saturday. Which timezone do they prefer?

Marco (VitaMed): Most of our team is ET, a couple in IST. Morning ET is best for engineers. Ideally: Sat 09:00-12:00 ET workshop, 13:00-14:00 ET PM demo, 15:00-16:00 ET office hours.

Priya (Trainer): I can run the 3-hour workshop (hands-on labs + pairing). Proposed prework (to be sent Fri): short checklist, API key + sample prompts, and a 15-minute pre-recorded intro. Will split labs into pairs.

Lee (Platform Eng): I can provision a Dedicated trial cluster and a preloaded dataset. Need a list of dataset names + model variants to preload. Also add a billing tag: vita-dedicated-trial. ETA: Fri 18:00 ET for infra ready.

Elena (CSM): Important: Marco said procurement wants to see measurable improvements on latency & cost before renewal. Let's add success metrics to the agenda and capture baseline numbers.

Tom (CS Ops): Good call. Priya, can you include a 20m session on interpreting the perf dashboard and cost breakouts?

Priya (Trainer): Yep. Draft agenda (Saturday ET): ```
- 09:00 intro + objectives (10m)
- 09:10 migration checklist walkthrough (20m)
- 09:30 infra deep-dive + cluster view (30m)
- 10:00 hands-on lab: model pinning + autoscale (60m)
- 11:00 perf profiling + KV cache mini-demo (30m)
- 11:30 Q&A + next steps (30m)
- 13:00 PM demo: sandbox product flows (60m)
- 15:00 office hours: drop-in (60m)
```
Also adding 15m on security & data handling per Marcos compliance ask.

Lee (Platform Eng): For the labs, no SSH - we'll provide containerized sessions via the sandbox UI and temporary API tokens. Example token creation: `curl -X POST https://internal.redwood/api/tokens -d '{"user":"vita_pair1"}'`

Marco (VitaMed): That works. For datasets: please preload "vita-clinical-samples-v2" and "vita-test-logs" and pin model variant `gptx-3.7-ded-q4`.

Elena (CSM): Headcount check: workshop = 7 infra, PM demo = 5, office hours = 3-5. Priya, plan breakout pairs accordingly.

Tom (CS Ops): I'll draft the invite copy. Suggest short subject: "VitaMed compact migration sprint (Sat)" with prereqs bullet: prework video + sandbox creds will be provided. Recording enabled. Anyone object? :thumbsup:

Priya (Trainer): +1

Lee (Platform Eng): +1

Marco (VitaMed): +1 thanks.

calendar-bot: Event created: "VitaMed compact migration sprint: Workshop"  Sat 09:00-12:00 ET  guests: 7 (tentative). Zoom: https://zoom.redwood.example/vitamedsprint

Tom (CS Ops): Sent tentative invites. I'll switch to confirmed once Lee marks infra ready and I attach prework.

Lee (Platform Eng): Cluster provisioned. Endpoint: https://dedicated.vita.redwood/api/v1; temp creds DMd to Marco. Load: datasets pre-seeded.

Marco (VitaMed): Received creds and forwarded to team. One compliance note: please include KMS usage details in the security slide.

Priya (Trainer): Added KMS slide + short demo of access controls. Also added a small section on how to read the cost panel in the console.

Elena (CSM): I'll compile a success metric template (baseline latency, median token cost, 95th pct latency) and attach to the invites. We'll capture post-session measurements for the renewal pack.

Tom (CS Ops): Confirmed: invites updated to "confirmed". Recording enabled and will be uploaded to /customers/vitam ed/sessions/sprint-2245678901.

Marco (VitaMed): Appreciate the quick turnaround. If we hit the throughput gains this week, we should be in good shape for renewal.

Lee (Platform Eng): One small runbook note: if anyone hits a stuck KV cache state during lab, run `./reset_cache.sh --pair $PAIR_ID` (I'll post file in the sandbox repo).

Priya (Trainer): Final note: I'll run a 10m retrospective at the end and capture follow-up tasks. See you Saturday. :rocket:

Elena (CSM): Thanks team. Closing loop here. If anything changes, post in this thread.

Marco (VitaMed): Thanks all! Looking forward. :handshake:
